properties.name: scos.privacy.enabled
properties.description: Whether the SCOS privacy masking module is active. Loads on import when true.

properties.name: scos.privacy.strict
properties.description: When true, missing crypto for hash/encrypt strategies is a startup error instead of degrading to a fixed mask.

properties.name: scos.privacy.max-payload-kb
properties.description: Maximum payload size in KB before masking truncates the input, bounding worst-case latency.

properties.name: scos.privacy.masking.config-path
properties.description: External path to the masking rules YAML. Empty falls back to the classpath privacy-masking.yml.

properties.name: scos.privacy.masking.default-patterns
properties.description: Enable the default builtin packs when the YAML does not list any.

properties.name: scos.privacy.log.register-converter
properties.description: Register the Logback %mask conversion rule programmatically at startup (no logback.xml edit). Set false to opt out.

properties.name: scos.privacy.crypto.secret
properties.description: Externalized secret for the default key provider (hash/encrypt). Prefer env SCOS_PRIVACY_CRYPTO_SECRET or Vault/KMS.
